product_metadata.title: Bambooee Reusable Bamboo Towel (2)
description: The Bambooee Perforated Bamboo Towels are the new reusable paper towel alternative to hit the market. These bamboo towels have the same look and feel as ordinary paper towels - they even come in a roll, mimicking how paper towels are normally consumed. The big difference, though, is that you don't just tear a sheet and throw it away. Instead, each sheet of bamboo towel is machine washable and reusable. In fact, when you purchase a roll of 20 Bambooee sheets, it replaces up to 60 paper towel rolls, helping you reduce waste and save money. Rayon made from a sustainibly sourced certified organic bamboo. Bambooee Towels are also strong, absorbent and durable.
